/*selectMasterWmCoTranBuyerPopList*/
SELECT B.COM_CODE BUYER , B.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NAME
, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'PO',DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL),NULL)),0) || '(' || NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'PO',NULL,DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL))),0) || ')' AS ERR_CNT
, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'IV',DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL),NULL)),0) || '(' || NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'IV',NULL,DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL))),0) || ')' AS ERR_CNT
, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'RE',DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL),NULL)),0) || '(' || NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'RE',NULL,DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL))),0) || ')' AS ERR_CNT
, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'GR',DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL),NULL)),0) || '(' || NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'GR',NULL,DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL))),0) || ')' AS ERR_CNT
, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'XX',DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL),NULL)),0) || '(' || NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'XX',NULL,DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL))),0) || ')' AS ERR_CNT
, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'PO',DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL),NULL)),0) || '(' || NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.GUBUN,'PO',NULL,DECODE(A.IF_FLAG,'N',1,'A',1,'E',1,NULL))),0) || ')' AS ERR_CNT
FROM IF_PROGRESS A /* 오류 현황 메인 */ , ICOMCMPY B /* 회원사정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND B.COM_CODE IN (SELECT C.BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG C /* 고객사별 담당자 정보 */ WHERE C.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')
AND C.KEP_DEPT = #{st_user_dept}
AND C.KEP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}
AND C.STATUS = 'C' )
AND B.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_com_name} || '%'
AND B.COM_CODE IN ( SELECT B.COM_CODE FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= 'ALL' AND COD3.CODE2 = #{st_user_id} UNION ALL SELECT MNG.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= MNG.KEP_DEPT AND COD3.CODE2 = #{st_user_id} AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' UNION ALL SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} UNION ALL SELECT COD.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD.CODE1 = CMPY.COM_CODE AND COD.CODE2 = #{st_user_id} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TEXT2 AND TEXT3 )
GROUP BY B.COM_CODE, B.COM_NAME_LOC
